notes: Hard bucket (sum 21). The whole task is a chained pipeline: build the guest first-boot, bring it up under software-only QEMU TCG (no KVM), mount a 9p virtfs host-root shared volume, chroot into it, compile a statically-linked inline-assembly program inside the emulated guest, run it to a known exit status, drive a parametric renderer loop to completion under simulation so it writes a first frame, then leave the emulator running as a persistent background service with a live monitor socket and a serial redirect that both accept external input. Hidden cases re-execute /app/run.sh on genuinely different scenarios (different exit status, frame dimensions, PRNG seed, and loopback ports), so run.sh must generalize rather than encode a single answer. Difficulty comes from dependent virtualization stages, background-service/socket statefulness, indirect guest-side failure diagnosis, and correctness that is exact (exit status integer, frame byte format). All four competencies meet or exceed their floors (C-01fe75ac is floor medium; C-3654b094, C-fc5cfb57, C-900a820e are floor hard), so documented_probe is null.
